description.value: Finch x Barley is a music-centric bar and restaurant in North Vancouver offering a globally influenced menu with a strong focus on Middle Eastern culinary traditions alongside craft beer, cocktails, wine, and spirits. The venue hosts regular Friday and Saturday night DJ sets and occasional live music, making it a lively social destination. A patio is available, and the food program spans brunch plates, dinner mains, and a full cocktail list.
